name: Magic wand
summary: Slim dark magic wand with a glowing white tip and a sparkle burst; for spells, wizards and fairy scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: the handle end rests on y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; about 380 px long at s = 1 (default 2 shows it well alone); use about 0.5 in a hand

params.name: anim
params.note: sparkle = a burst of stars pulses from the tip
